parameters.name: Override
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly overwrite existing images. Valid values:

- `true`: Forcibly overwrites existing images.

- `false`: Does not forcibly overwrite existing images.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The execution priority of the synchronization task. Synchronization tasks are executed in descending order of priority. Tasks with the same priority are executed in random order.

Valid values: 1 to 5.

Default value: 3.

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The ID of the image repository in the source instance.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The image tag in the source instance.

parameters.name: TargetNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetRepoName
parameters.description: The name of the image repository in the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetTag
parameters.description: The image tag in the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the account to which the target instance belongs.
